reference.name: Step Counter
reference.text:
Problem: Step Counter
START
INPUT stepsGoal
SET stepsSoFar TO 0
FOR d = 1 TO 7
    INPUT the steps for day d
    SET stepsSoFar TO stepsSoFar + the steps for day d
END FOR
SET remaining TO stepsGoal - stepsSoFar
SWITCH
    CASE remaining < 0
        PRINT "goal exceeded"
    CASE remaining == 0
        PRINT "goal met"
    CASE remaining > 0
        PRINT "not yet reached"
END SWITCH
END

reference.name: Battery Life
reference.text:
Problem: Battery Life
START
INPUT batteryPercent
INPUT hoursPerCharge
INPUT tripHours
SET chargeLeft TO batteryPercent
SET hoursRemaining TO 0
SET percentPerHour TO 100 / hoursPerCharge
WHILE chargeLeft > 0
    SET chargeLeft TO chargeLeft - percentPerHour
    SET hoursRemaining TO hoursRemaining + 1
END WHILE
IF hoursRemaining > tripHours
    PRINT "the battery will last"
ELSE IF hoursRemaining == tripHours
    PRINT "exactly enough"
ELSE
    PRINT "the battery dies early"
END IF
END

reference.name: Tip Calculator
reference.text:
Problem: Tip Calculator
START
INPUT bill
INPUT tipPercent
INPUT people
INPUT maxEach
SET tip TO bill * tipPercent / 100
SET tipPerPerson TO 0
FOR EACH person IN the people
    SET tipPerPerson TO tip / people
END FOR
SWITCH
    CASE tipPerPerson > maxEach
        PRINT "too high"
    CASE tipPerPerson == maxEach
        PRINT "tight"
    CASE tipPerPerson < maxEach
        PRINT "acceptable"
END SWITCH
END

reference.name: Step Counter, plain words, total and compare with the goal
reference.text:
Step counter
get the daily goal
the running total of steps starts at 0
repeat for each of the walks today
    add the steps from that walk to the running total
once all the walks are added, work out the steps remaining as the goal minus the total
if the steps remaining is below 0
    say the goal is exceeded
otherwise if the steps remaining is exactly 0
    say the goal is met
otherwise
    say the goal is not yet reached

reference.name: Battery Life, different keywords, hour by hour
reference.text:
Battery Life
READ percent, hoursPerCharge, tripLength
hours = 0
charge = percent
LOOP WHILE charge > 0
    charge -= 100 / hoursPerCharge
    hours += 1
ENDLOOP
IF hours < tripLength THEN SAY "dies early"
IF hours = tripLength THEN SAY "exactly enough"
IF hours > tripLength THEN SAY "lasts"

reference.name: Tip Calculator, plain words, dealt out one person at a time
reference.text:
Tip calculator
get the bill, the tip percentage, the number of people and the most each person will pay
work out the whole tip from the bill and the percentage
start the tip per person at 0
for every person in the group
    give that person an equal share, the whole tip divided by the number of people, as the tip per person
compare the tip per person with the most each person will pay
if it is more than the most, report too high
if it is exactly the most, report tight
if it is less than the most, report acceptable
